integrity: The universal two-dimensional claim is proved algebraically. The finite witness and all rational arithmetic are independently replayable from verify.py. Literature searches found nearby convergence and matrix-function-preservation results but no implication-equivalent coordinatewise positivity theorem; older terminology remains a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is limited to zero-start stationary Richardson iteration with the exact spectral-optimal fixed parameter on real SPD Stieltjes matrices. It does not classify arbitrary relaxation parameters, preconditioning, nonsymmetric M-matrices, or all higher-dimensional sign patterns. The exact three-dimensional witness is reducible; strict negativity implies qualitative persistence under small Stieltjes perturbations, but no perturbation radius is quantified.
title: Two dimensions protect optimal Richardson positivity; three dimensions do not
